title: CB Libs
headline: CB Libs v3.0.0
description: Major compatibility update; local release candidate pending framework validation.
changes: Added RedEM:RP Reboot and TPZ Core provider detection and initial adapters; MULTIcore uses its built-in RSG compatibility aliases.
Added resource-scoped callbacks and optional ox_lib UI with native context, text and progress fallbacks.
Added trusted-resource framework and inventory registration contracts for custom integrations.

Added generic native RedEM/TPZ storage routing and revision-pinned editable inventory patches, with server-owned access grants and metadata-preserving transfers. Install the matching patch to enable native storage.
Added HasPrisonAdapter detection for native and custom prison integrations. Live testing remains required.
